name: Filigree
author: E. T. Carter
description: A delicate ornamental lattice — a grid of thin glowing rounded-diamond outlines that pulse brighter in slow waves rolling across the field, like etched metal lacework catching light. Cell interiors stay near-black; the outlines trace palette colours by position.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the diagonal brightness wave rolls across the lace, lighting the diamonds in slow bands; 0 holds an even still net.

params.label: Lattice spacing
params.effect: Size of each diamond cell in CSS px - a dense fine ornamental lace at the minimum, an open airy net at the maximum.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Thickness of the lace strokes in CSS px - a delicate hairline filigree to a bold engraved lattice.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the lace strokes and the node jewels where the diamonds meet; low is a quiet etched net, high a luminous woven mesh.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Radius of the glowing centre jewel in each cell - the per-tile radial gradient. Small tightens it to a crisp point, large blooms a soft glow across the cell interior.

params.label: Dot glow
params.effect: Brightness of the centre jewels. 0 removes them for a pure outline lattice; high makes each cell centre a bright bead so the field reads as a net of lit nodes.

params.label: Cell fill
params.effect: Strength of a soft radial gradient filling each cell interior with the lace colour (instead of staying near-black). 0 keeps open etched cells; higher floods them into glowing tiles.

params.label: Fill radius
params.effect: How far the interior fill gradient reaches across the cell. Small pools the glow near the centre; large pushes it out toward the diamond outline.

params.label: Tile variation
params.effect: Randomises each cell independently - brightness and hue offset - so the lattice stops reading as a perfect repeat. 0 is uniform; high scatters lit and dim ornate tiles.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole lattice off the upright grid. 0 is axis-aligned diamonds; angled settings tilt the net diagonally across the frame.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Perspective foreshorten - the lattice leans away so cells grow toward one edge and shrink toward the other, giving a receding tabletop depth. 0 is flat-on.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Horizontal shear that slants the lattice columns, breaking the square symmetry into a rhomboid weave. 0 is upright.

params.label: Light angle
params.effect: Bearing of the relief light that rakes across the diamond faces. Rotates which sides of each bevel catch the highlight.

params.label: Light strength
params.effect: How strongly the steerable light shades the diamond facets. 0 is flat even lace; higher carves a beveled metal-relief read where lit faces shine and shadowed faces darken (like emboss, but on lacework).
